subject: general
question: A sum of money at certain rate of interest when compounded annually becomes Rs. 625 in 3 years and Rs. 675 in 4 years. What is the rate of Interest per annum?
solution:
Given:

A sum of money at certain rate of interest when compounded annually becomes Rs. 625 in 3 years and Rs. 675 in 4 years.

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years
